descriptions.w3d_items_remove_key_80357c90: Under the owner lock, erases from its item list every item whose key (vtable slot 0x08) equals key.
descriptions.w3d_items_derive_key_80357d78: Under the owner lock, appends to its item list the item derived (slot 0x14, with arg) from every item whose key equals key.
